field.ref_level_hint: 1 kHz lateral, 0 dB. Advisory only with a fixed level (USB turntable).
field.balance_hint: Level difference of the reference tone.
field.crosstalk_lr_hint: Channel separation; good MM cartridges reach 25–30 dB, see the cartridge data sheet.
field.tracking_reserve_hint: The AAPT ramp goes up to +12 dB; 11 = the whole ramp clean (½ dB tolerance at the end).
field.mono_cancel_hint: Residue of the out-of-phase tone in mono.
field.resonance_hint: Target band 8–12 Hz; below 7 Hz record warps, above 15 Hz music.
field.wf_weighted_hint: IEC weighted, including the eccentricity of the test record.
field.imd_hint: SMPTE 60 Hz + 4 kHz; look for the minimum by varying the arm height.
field.lf_100_hint: RIAA equalization of the phono stage, worse channel.
field.rumble_hint: Unweighted, without mains hum, relative to the reference; not comparable with DIN-B weighted figures.
map.standard.name: vinyl-check standard
map.standard.note: Default values of the app: good MM cartridges and solid turntables.
map.din45500.name: DIN 45500 (hi-fi minimum requirements)
map.din45500.note: Values of the withdrawn standard (1975) as quoted in the literature: wow & flutter ≤ 0.2 %, crosstalk attenuation ≥ 15 dB, unweighted rumble signal-to-noise ratio ≥ 35 dB. Speed ±1.5 % according to the literature; original text not verified.
map.lab.name: Strict lab (Hi-Fi News / AES)
map.lab.note: What test labs expect from very good turntables: speed ±0.1 %, wow & flutter ≤ 0.05 %, channel separation ≥ 28 dB. Rumble there is DIN-B weighted; transferred here to the unweighted 20–100 Hz measurement.
map.at3600l.name: Audio-Technica AT3600L (manufacturer data)
map.at3600l.note: Conical stylus. AT3600L data sheet: channel separation 18 dB, balance 2.5 dB. Turntable values from the manual of the Dual DTJ 301.1 USB, which ships with this cartridge: wow & flutter < 0.15 % DIN, channel separation > 15 dB; wider input level window for the fixed gain of USB turntables. Everything else as standard.
map.uccello.name: Transrotor Uccello Reference (manufacturer data)
map.uccello.note: Transrotor Uccello Reference (based on a Goldring design): channel separation 27 dB, balance 1 dB. Turntable values as standard.
error.warn_narrower_than_ok: {label}: the “check” limit must be wider than the “ok” limit
summary.thd_top_l_pct: THD left at the end of the ramp
summary.thd_top_r_pct: THD right at the end of the ramp
summary.thdn_top_l_pct: THD+N left at the end of the ramp
summary.thdn_top_r_pct: THD+N right at the end of the ramp
summary.sweep_lf_dev_db: Frequency response 40 Hz–1 kHz, max. deviation
summary.floor_clicks_per_min: Click floor: clicks in the silent groove
summary.floor_ticks_per_min: Click floor: crackle in the silent groove
result.antiskating.label: Anti-skating (bias)
result.antiskating.target: both channels clean up to +12 dB, or breaking up together
result.antiskating.clean: Both channels clean up to the end of the ramp ({top:+.1f} dB above the reference): anti-skating is within its window and the tracking headroom covers the whole band. Leave the settings as they are.
result.antiskating.too_strong: Left distorts first (from {left:+.1f} dB), right {right}: anti-skating too strong, the stylus leans against the outer groove wall. Reduce the bias slightly (Rega arms: towards mark 0) and repeat the ramp.
result.antiskating.too_weak: Right distorts first (from {right:+.1f} dB), left {left}: anti-skating too weak, the stylus leans against the inner groove wall. Increase the bias slightly and repeat the ramp.
result.antiskating.balanced: Both channels break up almost simultaneously (left {left:+.1f} dB, right {right:+.1f} dB): the bias is right. But the tracking headroom ends at {reserve:+.1f} dB above the reference → increase the tracking force in small steps (within the cartridge's specified range) or check the stylus.
result.tracking_reserve.label: Tracking headroom
result.tracking_reserve.text: Distortion (harmonics) at the end of the ramp: left {thd_l:.2f} %, right {thd_r:.2f} % (threshold {limit:.1f} %); THD+N including hum and noise: {thdn_l:.2f} / {thdn_r:.2f} %.
result.balance.label: Channel balance
result.balance.advice: First check the azimuth (crosstalk) and the channels of the phono stage/interface.
result.ref_level.label: Input level
result.ref_level.text: Reference tone at {ref:+.1f} dBFS, loudest band (+12 dB) at ≈ {peak:+.1f} dBFS.
result.ref_level.advice_hot: Too hot: reduce the gain on the interface, otherwise the anti-skating ramp clips.
result.ref_level.advice_quiet: Rather quiet: raise the gain on the interface a little, then mark the setting and leave it.
result.ref_level.advice_loud: Rather loud: hot-cut records may clip. With a fixed level (USB turntable) this cannot be changed; watch recordings for clipping then.
result.crosstalk_lr.label: Crosstalk left → right
result.crosstalk_rl.label: Crosstalk right → left
result.crosstalk.advice: Check azimuth, cantilever and wiring; compare with the cartridge data sheet.
result.azimuth.label: Azimuth
result.azimuth.equal: Crosstalk is the same in both directions.
result.azimuth.lr_stronger: Crosstalk left → right is {db:.1f} dB stronger.
result.azimuth.rl_stronger: Crosstalk right → left is {db:.1f} dB stronger.
result.azimuth.advice: Cartridge slightly twisted: check that it sits straight in the headshell (viewed from the front), then adjust the azimuth at the arm/headshell if possible.
result.mono_cancel.label: Mono cancellation (vertical tone)
result.mono_cancel.text: Residue of the out-of-phase tone in mono: {db:+.1f} dB.
result.mono_cancel.advice: Residue remains: check for channel mismatch, phase errors or crosstalk.
result.resonance.label: Arm/cartridge resonance
result.resonance.in_band: Right in the target band: arm and cartridge are a good match.
result.resonance.too_low: Too low: close to the frequencies of record warps (4–6 Hz); the stylus can lose contact.
result.resonance.slightly_high: Somewhat high (the cartridge is stiffer vertically than laterally); not critical as long as it stays below 15 Hz.
result.resonance.very_high: Unusually high for the fundamental arm/cartridge resonance: probably a secondary resonance (counterweight, arm mounting, headshell) or an effect of the phono stage.
result.resonance.silent_vertical: In the silent groove the arm oscillates vertically at {vert:.1f} Hz (excited by record warps): this is usually the fundamental resonance.
result.resonance.silent_both: In the silent groove the arm oscillates vertically at {vert:.1f} Hz and laterally at {lat:.1f} Hz (excited by record warps): this is usually the fundamental resonance.
result.resonance.at_end: Note: the peak lies at the end of the sweep; the actual resonance may be lower.
result.resonance.poor_fit: The model fits only moderately (±{rms:.1f} dB): look at the curve.
result.resonance.no_fit: The sweep does not go low enough for an evaluation.
result.speed.label: Speed
result.speed.advice_fast: Too fast: belt and pulley make little difference here, the speed comes from the motor control (synchronous motor: frequency trimmer, not the motor voltage; direct drive: pitch).
result.speed.advice_slow: Too slow: check the belt for slip (clean/replace), otherwise the motor control or pitch.
result.wf.label: Wow & flutter (weighted, 2σ)
result.wf.text: Of which once per revolution (eccentricity of record/centre hole) ±{ecc:.3f} %, drive without this component {drive:.3f} %.
result.imd.label: Intermodulation (arm height/VTA)
result.imd.text: Left {left:.2f} %, right {right:.2f} %. To set the arm height, compare runs at different heights: the lowest value wins (adjust the height at the arm base: clamping screw or spacer).
result.hf_10k.label: Treble (10 kHz vs. 1 kHz)
result.hf_10k.single_tone: Single tone at −20 dB: {left:+.1f} / {right:+.1f} dB (more scatter).
result.hf_10k.advice: With MM cartridges usually stylus resonance plus load capacitance; check the phono stage loading (47 kΩ, capacitance).
result.lf_100.label: Bass (100 Hz vs. 1 kHz)
result.lf_100.text: Left {left:+.1f} dB, right {right:+.1f} dB (RIAA equalization of the phono stage).
result.lf_100.advice: Check the RIAA equalization or the input stage; compare the channels.
result.sweep_hf.label: Frequency response, treble
result.sweep_lf.label: Frequency response, bass
result.sweep_dev.hf_top: At 20 kHz {left:+.1f}/{right:+.1f} dB (18 kHz is 8–10 dB quieter on the record itself, so only evaluated up to 16 kHz).
result.sweep_dev.lf_low: Below 40 Hz {db:+.1f} dB (a rise towards the resonance is normal).
result.click_floor.label: Click floor (silent groove)
result.click_floor.text: In the silent groove of the test record the detector finds {clicks:.0f} clicks and {ticks:.0f} crackle events per minute ({dur:.0f} s measured). This is what this chain (stylus, cartridge, test record) brings along; record sides are graded with this floor subtracted. Much higher than with another chain: clean the stylus, dust off or discharge the record, then record side 2 again.
result.rumble.label: Rumble / noise (silent groove)
result.rumble.text: Rumble (20–100 Hz, without mains hum) {rumble:+.1f} dB, A-weighted noise {noise:+.1f} dB relative to the reference.
result.rumble.no_ref: Rumble (20–100 Hz) {dbfs:+.1f} dBFS (no reference tone on this side).
result.rumble.line_hum: Distinct line at {freq:.0f} Hz = mains hum (check for interference from power supplies into cartridge/arm, or the grounding).
result.rumble.vertical_peak: Vertically, {freq:.1f} Hz stands out (resonance excited by warps).
result.rumble.advice: Check bearing, motor and placement; look at the lines in the spectrum (mains hum vs. motor).
warn.mono: Mono recording: nothing that compares the channels (balance, crosstalk, azimuth, anti-skating, vertical bands) can be measured. Set channels = 2 in the configuration.

warn.clipped_in_bands.one: {n} clipped sample in measurement bands: reduce the gain on the interface, the measurement cannot be used like this.
warn.clipped_in_bands.other: {n} clipped samples in measurement bands: reduce the gain on the interface, the measurement cannot be used like this.

warn.clipped_outside.one: {n} clipped sample outside the measurement bands (stylus set-down/lift-off), no effect on the values.
warn.clipped_outside.other: {n} clipped samples outside the measurement bands (stylus set-down/lift-off), no effect on the values.

warn.no_bands: No measurement bands of the test record recognized. Right record and side? Level high enough?

warn.unassigned.one: {n} section not assigned (e.g. announcements); it is not included in the findings.
warn.unassigned.other: {n} sections not assigned (e.g. announcements); they are not included in the findings.
